records.title: Writ challenging mutation entry
records.headline: The appellant claims title to the schedule property based on registered sale deed. The respondent disputes possession. Survey reference: 385/B. Court considered encumbrance and prior litigation.…
records.full_text_plain: The appellant claims title to the schedule property based on registered sale deed. The respondent disputes possession. Survey reference: 385/B. Court considered encumbrance and prior litigation.
